sourceMeasurements.sourceGeometry: closed conifer needle sprays and connected conifer branchlets

speciesAndUseBoundary: The source calls this a Scots pine (Pinus sylvestris), a temperate conifer. It is not claimed as a surveyed Hudson Valley tree or as the native local pine species. Woodland polygons locate the visual sampling area; they do not provide individual tree locations. Use only as a near-view appearance sample until a locally appropriate broadleaf asset is added; do not replace all NLCD deciduous forest with pines.
runtimePolicy: The GLB and its embedded textures are local application assets. Load and prepare instances before the scene is marked presentable; no movement-time network download or model replacement.
